# 7494 - 4-bit shift register

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7494.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7494.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 21 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7494 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7494.png) | ![7494 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7494.png) | ![7494 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7494.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | P1A | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 1 of stage A, used when PE1 is high |
| 2 | P1B | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 1 of stage B |
| 3 | P1C | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 1 of stage C |
| 4 | P1D | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 1 of stage D |
| 5 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 6 | PE1 | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset enable 1: while high, every stage whose P1 input is high is set to 1 at once |
| 7 | SER | input |  |  |  |
| 8 | CLOCK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 9 | QD | output |  | totem-pole | the only output (datasheet: OUTPUT); QA-QC are internal |
| 10 | CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; high sets all four stages to 0 at once, while the internal presets are inactive |
| 11 | P2D | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 2 of stage D, used when PE2 is high |
| 12 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 13 | P2C | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 2 of stage C |
| 14 | P2B | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 2 of stage B |
| 15 | PE2 | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset enable 2: while high, every stage whose P2 input is high is set to 1 at once |
| 16 | P2A | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked); controls pins 9; preset input 2 of stage A |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | QD = stateD | Serial output: the last of the four stages A, B, C, D. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- Internal preset of stage X is active when (PE1 AND P1X) OR (PE2 AND P2X); preset and clear do not depend on the clock
- CLEAR high and all internal presets inactive: QA = QB = QC = QD = 0 at once
- CLEAR low and the internal preset of a stage active: that stage = 1 at once (all presets active gives 1111)
- CLEAR low, presets inactive, CLOCK low: hold
- CLEAR low, presets inactive, rising edge of CLOCK: QA = SER, QB = old QA, QC = old QB, QD = old QC (shift right)
- Parallel load is done by clearing first and then presetting with PE1 or PE2

|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.4 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| CLOCK | QD | PLH | 25 | 40 |
| CLOCK | QD | PHL | 25 | 40 |
| preset (PEn with Pn) | QD | PLH |  | 35 |
| CLEAR | QD | PHL |  | 40 |

## Timing limits

| What | Pin | Against | Min ns | Min MHz |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pulse width | CLOCK |  | 35 |  |
| pulse width | CLEAR |  | 30 |  |
| pulse width | preset |  | 30 |  |
| setup (high-level data) | SER | CLOCK rising | 35 |  |
| setup (low-level data) | SER | CLOCK rising | 25 |  |
| hold | SER | CLOCK rising | 0 |  |
| max clock frequency | CLOCK |  |  | 10 |

## Not known

- Result when CLEAR is high while an internal preset is active: not in the function table.
- Typical delays from preset and clear: the table gives the maximum only.
- Setup/hold reference edge is not named in the table; the description says the data must be set up before the rising edge of the clock.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
